purpose: Durable routing surface for unresolved items from the 2026-08-24 complete health audit after immediate quick fixes. Current GitHub state remains authoritative and every execution lane must revalidate fresh main before acting.

route_definitions.CODEX_INTAKE: Bounded code remediation candidate. Must enter governed Codex intake, reproduce on fresh main, respect allowed scope, pass positive/negative tests and remain review-only with no automatic merge.
route_definitions.OPENAI_API_ANALYSIS_THEN_CODEX: Analysis-first task. Operational API execution is not currently auto-wired; packet is durable and ready for a future authorized API/operator lane. Code work begins only after a reproducible bounded defect is identified.
route_definitions.OBSERVE_ONLY: No code change. Gather expected production runs after a merged repair and reopen only fresh reproducing signatures.
route_definitions.EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: Blocked by access or external boundary. No code workaround may bypass authorization or governance.

items.title: Operations dashboard stale-handoff pointer truth
items.problem: Operations Dashboard can consume stale LATEST_HANDOFF pointers even when newer valid Daily Director or weekly artifacts exist, producing false STALE/RED observability.

items.title: Historical CFGI terminal lifecycle reconciliation
items.problem: Legacy MARKET gapfill can still fail as recoverable red even though a terminal provider-bounded contract already records zero historical MARKET rows and prohibits additional paid retries.

items.title: Forecast censor attribution
items.problem: Audit observed a high censor share among due/adjudicated forecasts. The rate alone does not distinguish legitimate point-in-time censoring from avoidable operational loss.
items.handoff_rule: No Codex patch until reason attribution identifies a reproducible prospective instrumentation defect.

items.title: Automation complexity and overlap review
items.problem: Large workflow count, scheduled owners and writers increase stale-contract, overlap and observability risk. Consolidation must be evidence-led rather than deletion-by-age.
items.handoff_rule: Only high-confidence reversible consolidations become Codex candidates.

items.title: Stale draft pull request hygiene
items.problem: PRs 49, 83, 96, 122 and 319 remain open drafts and must be compared with current main before any close/extract decision.
items.handoff_rule: No automatic PR closure or branch deletion.

items.title: Post-merge operational verification
items.problem: Merged repairs PR 557 and merged PRs 542/544 require expected production-run evidence before historical health signatures are considered fully cleared.

items.title: External Vault backup boundary verification
items.problem: External backup boundary cannot be independently claimed complete until the intended Vault repository is reachable and backup/readback receipts are verified.

global_guardrails: Fresh main/default-branch state is authoritative over this backlog.
Generated LATEST remediation files are not manually edited; governed controllers regenerate them from health and Codex intake evidence.
No task may change market gates, model weights, portfolio logic, canonical market semantics or API budgets unless separately authorized by framework governance.
No missing market/provider data may be fabricated or retrospectively inferred.
Restricted data remains in Donh91/secrets and credentials remain in GitHub Secrets; no remediation may copy them into the public control plane.
Automatic code write and automatic merge remain false.
A fresh non-reproducing task exits as clean no-op rather than forcing a patch.
